prompts.boy: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production 2D pixel RPG walk sprite sheet on truly transparent alpha background, no shadow, no ground, no text, no grid lines, no headings, no props outside character. Reference is character-design board ONLY. Create EXACTLY 16 separate full-body sprites in a strict equally spaced 4 columns by 4 rows grid. All 16 sprites identical size, same head size, SAME vertical foot baseline within each cell, centered, generous transparent gutters; no cropped hair or feet, no extra portraits. Row 1 faces DOWN toward viewer, row 2 faces LEFT, row 3 faces RIGHT, row 4 faces UP away from viewer with backpack visible. Columns are four consecutive natural walking animation frames: left foot forward, neutral, right foot forward, neutral. Feet visibly alternate, arms swing slightly, backpack remains consistent. Crisp hand-crafted 16-bit pixel clusters, warm university student, compact cute RPG proportions about three heads tall, readable at 40x60 pixels. Preserve blue and cream university sporty jacket, cream hoodie, brown hair and backpack from reference. No combat equipment, no fantasy outfit, no smooth painted shading. Sheet is a standalone game asset, not a design poster. Aim for 1024x1536 canvas, individual 256x384 cells; strict uniform 4x4 layout regardless of output canvas size. Male college student: short tousled brown hair, blue jacket, dark long trousers, brown shoes and brown backpack; natural friendly youthful face. Show the exact SAME boy in all frames.
